2609.01772.title: MemeCULT-1K: Benchmarking South Asian Cultural Context and Humor Understanding of Multimodal Models
2609.01772.paper_summary: Meme understanding goes beyond recognizing visual content or literal text; it requires implicit cultural knowledge and pragmatic inference that most vision-language models still lack. We introduce MemeCULT-1K, a multilingual benchmark of 1,000 South Asian memes in Bengali, English, and Hindi, where each meme is paired with a cultural context note and three human-written explanations, along with a supplementary set of 54 Bengali regional dialect memes. We evaluate thirteen popular Vision Language Models (VLMs) under two settings: meme-only and context-aware. Providing minimal cultural context yields consistent gains across all models and languages: mean SBERT similarity improves from 44.6 to 56.4 (+11.8), BLEURT from 37.3 to 42.3 (+5.0), and LLM-as-a-Judge scores from 2.57 to 3.43 out of 5 (+0.86). Fine-grained error analysis reveals that closed-source models fail mainly on entity and reference misidentification, while open-source models are bottlenecked by broader cultural knowledge gaps, with linguistic and phonological failures proving the most context-resistant across both. These results highlight the difficulty of culturally grounded meme understanding and motivate future work on explicit cultural knowledge integration. Our dataset and code are publicly available at TawsifDipto17/MemeCULT-1K.
2609.01772.paper_summary_zh: Meme 理解超越了對視覺內容或字面文本的識別；它需要隱含的文化知識和實用推理，而大多數視覺語言模型仍然缺乏這些。我們介紹了 MemeCULT-1K，這是一個包含 1,000 個南亞迷因的多語言基準，涵蓋孟加拉語、英語和印地語，每個迷因都配有文化背景說明和三個人類撰寫的解釋，以及一組 54 個孟加拉地方方言迷因的補充集。我們在兩種設置下評估了十三種流行的視覺語言模型（VLMs）：僅迷因和上下文感知。提供最少的文化背景在所有模型和語言中都產生了一致的增益：平均 SBERT 相似度從 44.6 提高到 56.4 (+11.8)，BLEURT 從 37.3 提高到 42.3 (+5.0)，LLM-as-a-Judge 的得分從 2.57 提高到 3.43（滿分 5 分）(+0.86)。細緻的錯誤分析顯示，封閉源模型主要在實體和參考誤識別上失敗，而開放源模型則受到更廣泛文化知識缺口的瓶頸，語言和語音失誤在兩者中都證明是最具上下文抗性。這些結果突顯了基於文化的迷因理解的困難，並激勵未來在明確文化知識整合方面的工作。我們的數據集和代碼在 TawsifDipto17/MemeCULT-1K 上公開可用。
